result.title: Learning When to Ask: Advisor-Aware Post-Training for SLM Agents
result.comment: Published at the OE-Agent Workshop (Open and Efficient Agentic AI for Resource-Constrained Environments) at ACML 2026 14 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables
result.summary: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly attractive for cheap, high-throughput agentic deployment, but they remain weak at multi-step reasoning and tool use that long-horizon tasks demand. We study how to post-train an SLM to seek advice from a stronger model and act on that advice itself, following an advisor-executor pattern. Out of the box, this pattern fails across open- and closed-source small-model families: wiring an SLM to an advisor is a harness-design matter that is not enough on its own. A post-training recipe is needed to teach the model when to ask, in a cost-aware fashion, and how to follow advice across steps. Our method, ADAPT (ADvisor-Aware Post-Training), is a multi-stage recipe that instills this behavior, learning entirely from the policy's own rollouts supervised by the environment's outcome, with no learned reward model or human annotation. Across three domains, compared to an untrained harness baseline, ADAPT improves success rate in embodied text reasoning (TextWorld) from 24.5% to 77.3%, code generation (LiveCodeBench) from 21.8% to 56.0%, and deep web search (GAIA) from 17.5% to 49.3%, while querying the advisor sparingly (~1.0-2.1 calls per task). On the two long-horizon domains it closes 70-85% of the gap to an oracle that perfectly times when to ask for advice, and on code generation it exceeds that oracle. The gains persist when the advisor is replaced by one unseen in training, showing that the learned help-seeking policy is robust to a changing advisor rather than tied to the one it was trained with.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何后训练小模型在 agent 任务中「何时向更强的 advisor 求助」，提出多阶段配方的 ADAPT，仅用策略自身 rollout 与环境结果监督，在 TextWorld、LiveCodeBench、GAIA 上以少量求助调用显著提升成功率，并验证换用未见 advisor 后仍有增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「成本感知地决定何时求助、并跨步利用外部信息」的决策训练，与 LVR 中何时调用视觉模块（LOOK）及何时停止（STOP）的收益–成本权衡可供核查，无奖励模型的自身轨迹结果监督也可能为轨迹训练与贡献分配提供线索；但对象是纯文本外部 advisor，迁移到视觉证据筛选仍需自行设计。
